calibration_set_audit.fallback_reason: Per-slice calibration sizes ([15, 15, 15]) are below minimum required (30); pooled global calibration set of 45 windows configured across slices.

findings_and_weaknesses.root_cause: Volume expansion (2x, 3x) shifts detector scores into the extreme upper tail of the 1x nominal calibration set. Conformal p-values drop to 1/(n+1) <= 0.0217, causing genuine benign windows to be falsely rejected as non-benign.

findings_and_weaknesses.issue: Attack Recall Suppression Under Growth Masking
findings_and_weaknesses.root_cause: Conformal gray band [0.05, 0.20] intercepts stealth attack windows whose signal is diluted by simultaneous volume growth, converting borderline attack detections into UNCERTAIN (abstain). While this elevates precision among decided verdicts, it degrades raw attack recall.

findings_and_weaknesses.limitation: Per-slice calibration sample size is only 15 windows, giving p_min = 1/16 = 0.0625, which cannot support alpha=0.05. Pooling across slices achieves 45 windows (p_min = 0.0217), but cross-slice pooling breaks slice isolation.
